question: What theoretical capacity does the paper's definition of 1C correspond to, and what first-discharge capacity does its share of theoretical capacity at 0.1C imply?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%theoretical%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%C-rate%' OR text ILIKE '%C rate%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 52 AND 68 OR (page=5 AND text ILIKE '%discharge%') ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT (CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '(\d+)% of theoretical', 1) AS DOUBLE)/100.0) * CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, 'C = (\d+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS first_discharge_mAh_g FROM atoms a, atoms b WHERE a.id='p5.L63' AND b.id='p5.L62'
